proposals_approval_check.value: ("proposals"."status" = 'approved' and "proposals"."approved_at" is not null and "proposals"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "proposals"."approval_note" is not null) or ("proposals"."status" <> 'approved' and "proposals"."approved_at" is null and "proposals"."approved_by_user_id" is null and "proposals"."approval_note" is null)
